children: Gibson Energy intends to renew its share-repurchase program to buy back up to 5% of its common shares over the course of the next year.
The liquids infrastructure company on Wednesday said that the Toronto Stock Exchange has approved its plan to launch a normal course issuer bid to buy back up to 7.3 million shares for cancellation.
Its shares have been on the rise in 2026, and are up about 23% since the start of the year to close Tuesday at 31.00 Canadian dollars ($22.27).
At Tuesday's closing price, the value of the shares intended for buyback would be worth about C$224.8 million.
Gibson can begin buying back shares starting Sept. 18.
